fact: UNECA's synopsis of African population statistics (August 2026) states that Eritrea has not conducted a population census since independence.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Demographic and Health Survey 2002 as the latest demographic, education or health household survey for Eritrea.
The World Bank's WDI lists the Priority survey, 1993, as the source of the most recent income and expenditure data for Eritrea.
